transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I finally came in because my mind’s been all over the place for months. Every CB chirp, a fuel price sign, some new idea—it pulls me off track. I’m missing details I normally wouldn’t, like a client’s delivery note or somebody I said I’d call back.
Did you struggle with this kind of distractibility and trouble staying organized when you were a child or teenager?
No, not really. This has been going on these past few months. I used to keep track of my deliveries and calls fine, but now every little thing—CB chatter, a sign, some idea—pulls my attention away.
Over these past few months, have you found yourself constantly worrying or feeling unable to control your worries?
I’m not sure I’d call it worrying. My mind just keeps getting pulled in different directions; it doesn’t feel like I’m sitting there worried about things all the time.
Have you noticed a decreased need for sleep, feeling fully rested after just a few hours?
Yeah. Most nights I only get maybe three or four hours, then I’m up before daylight feeling ready to roll, not worn out.
Have you ever experienced periods in the past where you felt distinctly depressed, hopeless, or lost pleasure in things for weeks at a time?
I can’t really think of a time like that, no. I’ve had normal bad days, but not weeks where I felt hopeless or stopped enjoying everything.
Have these changes caused major problems or completely disrupted your ability to do your job?

Not completely, but it’s caused problems. I’ve had dispatch and clients repeat things I should’ve kept track of, and a couple sales follow-ups slipped because I was chasing too many ideas at once. At home, my wife and daughter are kind of walking on eggshells around me. I can tell it’s putting strain on them.
Have you ever needed to go to the hospital or be admitted for care because of these symptoms?
No, I haven’t ever been admitted to a hospital for this.
During this period, have you felt unusually important, uniquely gifted, or like you had special powers or abilities far beyond normal?
Yeah. I got it in my head I could rebuild the whole driver training program myself and make it run better than the bosses ever could, even though that’s really not my lane.
Have you engaged in any risky behaviors recently, such as spending unusually large amounts of money or making reckless financial decisions?
I haven’t really noticed anything like that. What kind of financial decisions do you mean?
Have these symptoms caused severe disruption in your day-to-day life, to the point where you are unable to function normally?

I wouldn’t say I’m completely unable to function, but it’s definitely causing problems. At work, I’ve had dispatch and clients repeat things I should’ve kept track of, and a couple sales follow-ups slipped because I was chasing too many ideas at once. At home, my wife and daughter are kind of walking on eggshells around me. I can tell it’s putting strain on them when I’m supposed to be helping.
